help-signin-online.claim: Signing in to Collect needs a connection.

evidence.quote: Online-only mode: offline login is no longer supported
Logging in requires an internet connection, so offline login isn't available.

help-wrong-password.claim: Wrong credentials message; sign-in uses the registered email (the username); reset by email in Collect.

evidence.quote: "usernamePasswordIncorrect": "Your username or password may be incorrect, please try again.",
"enterEmail": "Please enter your email to reset your password",

help-empty-app.claim: A refused organization name still creates the account, unlinked; an unmatched account shows an empty app.

evidence.quote: // Refused. The ACCOUNT is still created — an unidentified organization
// an account match no records and show an empty app with no error.

help-custom-forms-refresh.claim: Custom forms reach the phone when the Custom Forms list is refreshed (not at sign-in); the empty state tells you to refresh.

help-search.claim: Online, search matches the start of one field; offline it reads only saved records, by name and nickname.

help-sync-manual.claim: Nothing is sent until Retry in Offline Sync, despite the banner.

evidence.quote: "offlineBanner": "You're offline. Records will save and sync automatically."

help-sync-failures.claim: Offline Sync distinguishes offline and server-refused failures; forms stay on the device; Discard is permanent.

evidence.quote: "failedOffline": "You are offline. Reconnect to the internet and try again.",
"failedOnline": "The server did not accept these forms. Try again in a few minutes, and contact support if it keeps happening.",
"stillOnDevice": "Your forms are still saved on this device. Nothing has been lost.",
Discarding deletes it from this device permanently and it cannot be recovered.

help-household-queue.claim: Offline households are not listed in Offline Sync; they are sent only with other queued forms, and with nothing else queued there is no Retry button.

help-logout-blocked.claim: Logging out is blocked offline and warns about unsynced records.

evidence.quote: They will stay on the device, but you cannot sync them until you log back in.

help-export-small.claim: Exports follow the organization name and its nicknames; nicknames are added by Puente staff.

evidence.quote: 'editOrganizationAliases requires the master key or the puente_staff role',

help-publish-silent.claim: Manage does not show publish failures; errors go to the console.

help-feedback-email.claim: Contact us / Feedback opens an email to info@puente-dr.org.

help-version-label.claim: Collect settings show the app version.

help-staff-add-org.claim: Puente staff add organizations to the Manage sign-up list by hand; the link opens an email.

evidence.quote: Puente staff add organizations by hand, which is what keeps the list worth trusting.

help-staff-org-change.claim: People cannot change their own organization; email info@.

help-staff-aliases.claim: Org admins see Save spellings, but saving nicknames requires Puente staff.

evidence.quote: 'editOrganizationAliases requires the master key or the puente_staff role',

help-staff-last-admin.claim: The last administrator cannot be demoted or deactivated; staff can appoint admins.
